summary: Iteration 46 regression: extended LEAD_STATUSES (11 values) + Lead Journey timeline verified end-to-end on backend and frontend. 16/16 new backend tests pass, iteration-45 regression (14/14) still passes, and every frontend touchpoint (13 filter chips, 11 board cols, 11 status chips, LeadJourney with journey-event-* entries, CrmAnalytics 11 snap rows, Staff-scoped view) is intact.

backend.iteration46_new: 16/16 PASS (PATCH status→post-conv appends status_history from/to/by_name; invalid status→400; multi-step 4-hop accumulation; POST /followups with status=fee_paid pushes both a follow_up and a status_history entry with note='via follow-up'; GET /leads/stats returns all 11 by_status keys for super/office/staff scopes; no legacy 'contacted' key; CSV /leads/bulk still defaults status='new')
backend.iteration45_regression: 14/14 PASS (Interested / Attending admins / Visit PATCH / Convert flows unchanged)

frontend.lead_journey: Renders with journey-event-created, journey-event-visit, journey-event-status-<id> entries. Clicking chip 'application_submitted' issued PATCH /api/leads/{id}, toast 'Marked Application Submitted' appeared, badge updated to 'Application Submitted', journey grew from 10→11 events immediately.
frontend.crm_analytics_snap: 11/11 crm-snap-* rows visible on Office Admin CRM Overview tab
frontend.staff_scope: Staff (staff.blr@kmfoundation.online) sees 13 chips + 8 assigned leads only; extended chip strip available

critical_code_review_comments: routers/leads.py _status_event helper is clean and shared across PATCH/convert/interested/followups — good DRY.
PATCH /api/leads/{id}: status_history is only appended when new status != old status — correct idempotency.

POST /api/leads/{id}/followups appends status_history with note='via follow-up' via $push, but that push key is `status_history` and it's added alongside `follow_ups` in the same $push dict — verified working in tests.
Frontend LeadJourney sorts by timestamp asc and includes created/visit/follow_up + status_history — matches spec.
test_credentials: Super admin/office admin/staff per /app/memory/test_credentials.md; used safe phone 0000000000 for WA path.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral TEST_it46 leads created & deleted in teardown_module. Also reverted the touched 'Gibi Philip' lead back to status='converted' after UI transition test so production seed remains untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: LEAD_STATUSES is now the 11-value tuple; CONVERTED_STATUSES groups the 5 post-conv states used by /analytics and LeadFunnel conversion-rate math. Every status write in leads.py already appends a status_history event via _status_event. LeadJourney (frontend) reads created_at + visit + follow_ups + status_history and renders journey-event-{kind}[-id].
